hero.title: Swiss company
hero.subtitle: Search, qualify, and track companies from the Swiss commercial register. Powered by live SHAB data, Machine Learning and AI classification — so your pipeline stays relevant.

features.title: Everything for Swiss market research
features.subtitle: From live register data to finding undiscovered leads — Helvex covers every step of finding and qualifying Swiss companies.

data.title: Data Foundation
data.tagline: Live Swiss commercial register data with full SHAB mutation history.
data.f1: Automated SHAB ingestion keeps records current
data.f2: CHE UID anchoring for reliable joins and exports
data.f3: Mutation timeline — name, signer, address changes
data.f4: Regional filtering by seat, canton, and locality
data.f5: Normalized purpose text for scoring and clustering

ai.title: AI & Scoring
ai.tagline: Qualify thousands of companies with LLM classification and fit scoring.
ai.f1: AI fit score — numeric relevance for fast triage
ai.f2: Batch and immediate LLM classification flows
ai.f3: Flex rescoring whenever targeting criteria change
ai.f4: Auto-score newly discovered companies on entry
ai.f5: Custom ML stopwords for cleaner clustering

search.title: Search & Discovery
search.tagline: Find and track the right companies with filters, collections, and digests.
search.f1: Combine status, geography, score, and purpose filters
search.f2: Organize targets into reusable named collections
search.f3: Daily digest emails for newly matched companies
search.f4: Web search enrichment for additional signal
search.f5: Map view with lat/lon and cluster inspection

workspace.title: Workspace & Scale
workspace.tagline: Team workspace, transparent billing, and enterprise-grade controls.
workspace.f1: Shared org with common data and credit balance
workspace.f2: CSV exports — basic (UID/Name) or full detail
workspace.f3: Per-action credit economy with CHF conversion
workspace.f4: Top-up bonuses that scale with your plan tier
workspace.f5: BYO LLM keys, queue priority, and audit history

pricing.subtitle: Start for free, then scale up as your needs grow. No hidden fees — only pay for what you use.
